about_the_game:
[The game is still in early development, and most of the visuals are subject to change.]

Collect gloops, astonishing aquatic creatures from outer space, and create the perfect environment for their well-being. Fill up your encyclopedia and complete a variety of missions to become the greatest gloopologist in the galaxy!

🎣 Catch the gloops

Using your trusty Gloop Catcher 2000™, choose a destination and a fishing zone to catch unique gloops and decorations to expand your collection.

🐠 Study and care for your gloops

Place them in different tanks, adjust their environment, and observe their interactions. Experiment to uncover their preferences and fill out your encyclopedia with your discoveries!

🪴 Customize your aquarium

Unleash your creativity by decorating your workspace. Choose from a variety of themes and decorations to build a truly unique environment.

✨ Showcase your discoveries

Welcome fellow scientists to your research base, showcase your findings, and earn research points to upgrade your base by sharing knowledge about the gloops.

🧪 Achieve your goals

Take on scientific challenges across various missions! With each new mission, you'll unlock new fishing spots, creatures, and decorations.

  • A campaign mode with missions

  • 3 to 5 hours of gameplay

  • Tons of gloops to collect!

  • Themes and decorations to customize your aquarium

  • A fun and relaxing universe in outer space

  • A trusty robo-cat, always ready to lend a paw-sitive hand! 😸
